result_format: uint64 raw sum of squared quantized differences

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Write bit0=1 starts. Read bits: busy0/done1/idle2/fault3.

registers.name: TRAIN_DATA
registers.description: Write low16 signed two-complement feature; low-byte write strobes apply; auto-increment address once.

registers.name: QUERY_DATA
registers.description: Write low16 feature; low-byte write strobes apply; auto-increment address once.

registers.name: DIST_LO
registers.description: Uint64 result bits31..0; no address increment.

registers.name: DIST_HI
registers.description: Uint64 result bits63..32; increment DIST_ADDR once on RVALID && RREADY.

registers.name: COMPLETED_COUNT
registers.description: Real successful PL completion count; uint32 wraparound.

registers.name: LAST_CYCLES
registers.description: FCLK cycles of most recently completed compute pass.

registers.name: ERROR
registers.description: Latched error code; valid start clears.

notes: This JSON describes a software contract, not a generated HWH or evidence of a built FPGA.
AW/W are independently held and committed once both accepted; BVALID and RVALID stay asserted until handshake.
Busy nonzero-strobe writes are rejected without modifying model/query RAM; fault stays latched until valid start.
DONE is not read-cleared; a non-busy start request clears DONE, and a valid start also clears FAULT and ERROR.
Large RAM arrays are not reset; upload a complete model and query before inference.
DIST_HI increments only after successful read handshake; last valid result can advance pointer to MAX_ROWS; extra read is rejected.
